consequence.statement: Clusters still ZooKeeper-based must be migrated to KRaft before upgrading to Strimzi 0.46.0 or newer, because ZooKeeper support and the migration path are removed.
consequence.remediation: Migrate all clusters to KRaft using a Strimzi version that still supports migration, then upgrade to 0.46.0 or newer.

original.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 removes support for ZooKeeper-based clusters and for ZooKeeper-to-KRaft migration, so all clusters must already be on KRaft before upgrading to 0.46.0 or newer.

decision.reason: [ev-4c2676e4665a] says support for ZooKeeper-based clusters and for ZooKeeper-to-KRaft migration has been removed, and tells operators to make sure all clusters are using KRaft before upgrading to 0.46.0 or newer. That is a required step before the upgrade, which matches migration-required (action class). The statement repeats the evidence. The remediation follows from it: migration is removed in 0.46.0, so it has to happen on an earlier version. High severity is reasonable for removed support of a whole cluster mode.
